name: ConnectomeBench2
description: Proofreading--correcting segmentation errors in 3D brain reconstructions--is the rate-limiting step in synapse-resolution connectomics. We release ConnectomeBench2, a unified multi-species dataset of over 716,485 expert-labeled proofreading decisions with >4,500,000 associated images spanning four major open connectomes (mouse, human, zebrafish, fly), spanning both split and merge error correction.
